Q: Thank you for taking the time to speak with me today. This recorded statement concerns the rear-end collision you
reported in Conroe, Texas. Can you confirm you are the driver of the vehicle involved?
A: Yes, I was driving my own car that day.
Q: Please describe how the collision happened, in your own words.
A: I had stopped at a red light on the main road, and I was waiting for the light to change. The other vehicle came up
behind me and didn't slow down in time. I felt a hard jolt from the back.
Q: Were you wearing your seatbelt, and did the airbags deploy?
A: Yes, I had my seatbelt on. The airbags did not deploy, but my head snapped forward and then back against the
headrest.
Q: Did you feel any pain or symptoms right after the impact?
A: My neck was stiff almost immediately, and by that evening I had a sharp ache across the back of my shoulders that
kept getting worse.
Q: Have you sought medical treatment since the collision?
A: Yes, I went to an urgent care clinic the same day, and then I started seeing a physical therapist. They diagnosed
me with whiplash.
Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?
A: Yes, I still have neck pain, and I get headaches when I sit at a desk for long periods. Turning my head to check my
blind spot when driving is difficult.
Q: Is there anything else you would like to add to your statement?
A: No, I think I have covered everything. I am still working with my doctor on the treatment plan.
Q: Thank you. This concludes the recorded statement.
</page>
